denied: Email operations are available only in the Admin workspace of an Admin account.
intro: Review recorded email processing for new inquiries and newly verified accounts. This view contains operational metadata only, without recipient addresses or message content.
accepted_note: Accepted means the email provider acknowledged the request. It does not confirm inbox delivery, reading or a reply.
history_note: Historical inquiries and accounts are not replayed. This page does not send messages or enable processing.
load_error: Email status is unavailable. No empty queue or delivery outcome has been inferred. Refresh to check again.
uncertain: The provider outcome is uncertain. A retry is held for review to avoid duplicate email.
eligible_after: Earliest review time: {{date}}. A time alone does not authorize a retry.
no_retry: No manual retry is currently authorized by this status record.
empty: No email jobs were returned for this page and these filters. This does not prove that an earlier email was delivered or recreate historical records.

flags.title: Server processing settings
flags.enabled: Enabled in the server settings. This is not proof that a worker is running or an email was delivered.
flags.paused: Paused in the server settings. No activation is available on this page.
flags.note: These are the flags returned with this status report. A retry authorization cannot enable either setting. No SMS or automated WhatsApp service is activated here.

confirm.title: Authorize one eligible attempt?
confirm.body: The server will recheck this job's eligibility, cooldown and attempt limit. This action authorizes one attempt for the enabled worker; it makes no provider request itself and does not confirm delivery. Paused processing stays paused. A later failure needs a new manual review.

notices.authorized_active: The server authorized one pending attempt. Processing is enabled, but no worker execution or inbox delivery has been confirmed. Status is being reloaded.
notices.authorized_paused: The server authorized one pending attempt, but processing is paused. This action did not enable processing or send an email. Status is being reloaded.
notices.not_retryable: The server declined the retry because this job is no longer eligible. No attempt was authorized by this action. Review the refreshed status.
notices.unconfirmed: The authorization result could not be confirmed. It may have been recorded. No automatic retry will be made; review the refreshed status before another action.
notices.stale: This status is no longer fresh enough to authorize a retry. It is being refreshed; review the current record before choosing again.
